text: {"opportunities":[{"name":"GitHub lead research and email draft","description":"Search a GitHub username, open their profile and top repo, then compose a hiring lead email with followers, top repo, stars, language and latest post.","site":"github","steps":["Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter","Click the Users results tab","Open the matching user profile","Open the top repo and note stars and language","Open mail compose, enter To address","Enter subject 'Lead for <role>: <username>'","Enter body summarizing followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post","Discard/close the draft"],"parameters":["github username","role","followers","top repo","stars","language","latest post"],"confidence":0.85,"instances":[{"start_t":108.3,"end_t":311.6,"values":"karpathy, ML Research Engineer, nanoGPT"},{"start_t":474.8,"end_t":540.6,"values":"gaearon, Staff Frontend Engineer, react/react"},{"start_t":737.5,"end_t":817.7,"values":"simonw, Developer Advocate, llm"}]},{"name":"Person Wikipedia lookup + company Wayback snapshot to note","description":"Look up a person on Wikipedia, view an Internet Archive snapshot of a given site for a given year, and save a combined note.","site":"wikipedia / archive.org / notes","steps":["Search the person on Wikipedia and read the summary","Open Wayback Machine and enter the domain","Select the year and a snapshot date","Read the homepage headline","Open notes and create a new note combining person facts and snapshot headline"],"parameters":["person name","domain","year","snapshot day index"],"confidence":0.8,"instances":[{"start_t":323.9,"end_t":449.7,"values":"Satya Nadella, microsoft.com, 2014"},{"start_t":554.9,"end_t":724.6,"values":"Jacinda Ardern, nasa.gov, 2019"},{"start_t":870.7,"end_t":940.8,"values":"Tim Berners-Lee, w3.org, 2005"}]}]}

opportunities.name: GitHub lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open their profile and top repo, then compose a hiring lead email with followers, top repo, stars, language and latest post.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter
Open the top repo and note stars and language
Open mail compose, enter To address
Enter body summarizing followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post

opportunities.name: Person Wikipedia lookup + company Wayback snapshot to note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view an Internet Archive snapshot of a given site for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person on Wikipedia and read the summary
Open Wayback Machine and enter the domain
Select the year and a snapshot date
Open notes and create a new note combining person facts and snapshot headline
